config.initialization: fresh random, never load a historical policy
config.normalization: raw7D observations; no VecNormalize; environment clipped normalized4D actions
config.success: distance<0.10 AND speed<0.15 for5consecutive policy steps
config.training_target_rng: Gymnasium seed=training_seed+rank, continued across resets; actual visits logged
config.resume: skip verified completed seeds; interrupted seed restarts from scratch, retained attempts

train_specification.audit: every actual target reset logged; exact coordinate exclusion from Val/Final; no resampling
train_specification.cross_seed_target_stream_overlap: seed+rank rule retained; neighboring seeds share7 of8 underlying target RNG seeds; independent network/action/minibatch seeds, not disjoint environment streams

historical.provenance_limits: historical report lacks original checkpoint SHA and full Train stream; source/current ZIP metadata verified, exact historical stochastic training replay not claimed

statistics.seed_ci: exploratory t95 interval with df4; same fixed200targets, not200seeds
statistics.target_ci: Wilson95 per policy, descriptive target-cohort uncertainty
statistics.paired: same physical snapshot; time/length common-success targets only
